_comment: The App Store screenshots, one entry each: what it shows, which platforms carry it, and the demo arguments that stage it (TAB/SCREEN/SEARCH/PICK/SELECT/SPREAD, as Scripts/demo.sh and run-mac.sh take them). `store` is the carousel order; `shoot.sh` walks `capture` order and stages each shot by relaunching the demo with its arguments, so nothing is staged by hand. A `stage` note means something is still done by hand before the capture (shoot.sh pauses for it). See SCREENSHOTS.md.

read.title: A word tapped on the page
read.about: The hero: the page frozen on the screen, 吾輩 picked, its reading and pitch in the drawer. The whole idea in one frame.

phrase.title: A phrase, every word read
phrase.about: A longer selection: the phrase looked up whole, then each word with its reading, pitch and kept mark — shows the selection is a stretch, not one word.

dictionary.title: The dictionary, with pitch
dictionary.about: Search results for みる: headwords, readings with the pitch drawn, the estimated ones marked. On the Mac the three columns.

review.title: A review, typed
review.about: The sentence as it stood on the page, the word marked, the reading asked for by typing.

lesson.title: A lesson
lesson.about: A card met for the first time: the word, its sentence, its meaning, the kanji — start it or leave it for later.

study.title: The week ahead
study.about: The Study tab: what is due, the week ahead by quarter day in the colours of the birds coming up, the ranks.

cards.title: The cards, by book
cards.about: The card list by stack with the collections above; on the Mac the split with a card open.

progress.title: Progress
progress.about: The graphs: answers per day, the ranks over time.
